name: MCIPCB13B
tagline: Intel Core Ultra / Core 3 industrial PC with DDR5 and triple display
description: MCIPCB13B supports Intel Core Ultra Series 1/2 or Core 3 Series processors, up to 64GB DDR5, dual Gigabit LAN, two RS-232 ports, two HDMI outputs and DisplayPort. USB allocation and 2.5-inch storage availability depend on the selected processor platform.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: Optional Intel Core Ultra Series 1/2 U5/U7 processors; Intel Core 3 Series 304/305/315/320/330/350/360 processors

specifications.label: Network
specifications.value: 2 x Realtek RTL8111H Gigabit Ethernet ports

specifications.label: USB
specifications.value: Core Ultra Series 1/2: 4 x USB 3.0, 4 x USB 2.0; Core 3 Series: 2 x USB 3.0, 6 x USB 2.0

specifications.label: Ports
specifications.value: 1 x headphone jack; 1 x microphone jack

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 2280 NVMe SSD; 1 x 2.5-inch HDD/SSD (not supported on Core 3 Series)

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 2232 for Wi-Fi; 1 x M.2 3042 for 3G/4G, with onboard SIM slot; 2 x antenna connectors

specifications.label: Environment - Operating
specifications.value: Operating temperature: -20 C to +60 C; storage temperature: -30 C to +70 C; storage humidity: 10%~90% at 30 C, non-condensing
